```{r}
#Do Chi-squared tests to statistically compare differences between Tajima's D distributions over time for each population

# Discretize Tajima values into bins
bins <- c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)

# Create a contingency table
table_data_fall96_01 <- matrix(0, nrow = length(bins) - 1, ncol = 2)
colnames(table_data_fall96_01) <- c("fall1996_2000", "fall2001_2005")
rownames(table_data_fall96_01) <- paste("[", bins[-length(bins)], ",", bins[-1], "]", sep = "")
for (i in 1:(length(bins) - 1)) {
  table_data_fall96_01[i, 1] <- sum(angsd_sfs_fall1996_2000_pestPG_filtered$Tajima > bins[i] & angsd_sfs_fall1996_2000_pestPG_filtered$Tajima <= bins[i + 1])
  table_data_fall96_01[i, 2] <- sum(angsd_sfs_fall2001_2005_pestPG_filtered$Tajima > bins[i] & angsd_sfs_fall2001_2005_pestPG_filtered$Tajima <= bins[i + 1])
}
# Perform the Chi-Squared Test
chi_squared_result_fall96_01 <- chisq.test(table_data_fall96_01)

# Create a contingency table
```
